header.purpose: Shared golden read-back observation vectors. The Rust test suite validates expected_native_valid (native structural + digest + shape rules); the Brain test suite validates expected_brain_envelope_valid and expected_service_verdict. Contract mismatch must be 0.

nan.description: payload containing a non-JSON-safe NaN (constructed programmatically)

exact_bound.description: payload whose canonical JSON is exactly 262144 bytes

over_bound.description: payload whose canonical JSON is 262145 bytes

vectors.description: fully valid native_readback observation
vectors.expected_reason: trusted observation satisfies the deterministic expectation

vectors.description: Unicode subject and payload must validate and digest deterministically
vectors.expected_reason: Unicode content is JSON-safe and digest-stable

vectors.description: observation bound to a different plan id
vectors.expected_reason: observations can never cross plan boundaries

vectors.description: observation bound to a different receipt id
vectors.expected_reason: observations can never cross receipt boundaries

vectors.description: observation subject differs from the expectation subject
vectors.expected_reason: observations can never cross subject boundaries

vectors.description: observation carries a different verification capability
vectors.expected_reason: observations can never cross verification capability boundaries

vectors.description: native truncation shape: truncated=true plus parser_status=truncated
vectors.expected_reason: truncated observations can never verify

vectors.description: truncated=true reported with parser_status=parsed is never emitted natively
vectors.expected_reason: the truncated flag alone still fails closed in Brain

vectors.description: truncated=true with parser_status=malformed is structurally invalid
vectors.expected_reason: a truncated observation cannot claim malformed at the same time

vectors.description: parser could not produce a structured payload
vectors.expected_reason: malformed observations can never reach the evaluator

vectors.description: binding cannot represent the payload in the V1 format
vectors.expected_reason: unsupported observations fail closed before the evaluator

vectors.description: observed_at precedes attempt_started_at
vectors.expected_reason: an observation can never precede its own attempt

vectors.description: observed_at is far in the future of the trusted clock
vectors.expected_reason: future timestamps are rejected as replay/forgery candidates

vectors.description: attempt_started_at precedes the receipt spawn_started_at
vectors.expected_reason: a read-back attempt can never start before the executed process spawned

vectors.description: observed_at precedes the receipt accepted_at
vectors.expected_reason: observed_at before attempt_started_at is structurally invalid

vectors.description: the same observation id finalizes two attempts
vectors.expected_reason: one observation id can only finalize one attempt of one outcome

vectors.description: payload_digest does not match the payload
vectors.expected_reason: digests are recomputed; a mismatch fails closed

vectors.description: payload is a JSON array, not an object
vectors.expected_reason: the V1 payload contract requires a JSON object

vectors.description: payload contains a non-JSON-safe NaN
vectors.expected_reason: non-finite numbers can never enter an observation payload

vectors.description: payload exactly at the 256 KiB canonical JSON bound
vectors.expected_reason: the byte bound is inclusive

vectors.description: payload exceeds the 256 KiB canonical JSON bound
vectors.expected_reason: oversized payloads are rejected before any evaluation

vectors.description: payload nested 100 levels deep remains JSON-safe
vectors.expected_reason: bounded structural depth is JSON-safe

vectors.description: observation attempt id differs from the in-flight attempt
vectors.expected_reason: an observation can only finalize its own reserved attempt

vectors.description: source_adapter absent
vectors.expected_reason: the trusted native source identity is required

vectors.description: source_binding absent
vectors.expected_reason: the trusted native binding identity is required

vectors.description: process_timed_out and process_cancelled both true
vectors.expected_reason: a read-back process cannot be timed out and cancelled at once

vectors.description: negative process_duration_ms
vectors.expected_reason: duration must be a non-negative integer

vectors.description: unknown verification_level
vectors.expected_reason: verification_level is a closed vocabulary

vectors.description: empty observation_id
vectors.expected_reason: observation ids are required

vectors.description: both plan and subject crossed at once
vectors.expected_reason: the first violated binding rejects the observation

vectors.description: subject_key exceeds 200 characters
vectors.expected_reason: subject keys are bounded

vectors.description: replayed observation id on a second attempt of the same outcome
vectors.expected_reason: an observation id is single-use per outcome attempt history

vectors.description: synthetic_test source observation remains valid
vectors.expected_reason: synthetic_test is the documented test-bridge source

vectors.description: payload carrying a 100 KiB string is within the bound
vectors.expected_reason: large-but-bounded payloads are valid

vectors.description: parser_status=truncated without the truncated flag
vectors.expected_reason: a truncated status can never verify, with or without the flag
